context_for_next_testing_agent: HR module iteration 11 adds: 1) educations[] array with +/- repeatable form in Education tab, 2) Certificate scans (multi-file) in Documents tab with amber background, 3) Contract tab expanded: contract_signing_date (renamed from contract_start_date), work_start_date, contract_end_date + contract_indefinite checkbox, probation_end_date, contract_reminder checkbox (default checked), position_change select (Bəli/Xeyr), payment_system select (Vaxtamuzd/İşəmuzd), 3 file uploads (position_instructions_file, employment_contract_file, position_change_file), 4) Salary tab: salary_supplement, bonuses fields. Backend uses dict so all fields are accepted. Detail view shows all new fields in respective tabs. Salary tab shows 4 cards (Gross, Net, Əlavə, Mükafatlar).

repeatable_educations.details: Education tab has 'Təhsil 1' card, 'Təhsil əlavə et' button adds more educations, X button removes educations. Backend accepts educations[] array.

certificate_scans.details: Documents tab has 'Sertifikatlar' section with amber background (bg-amber-50). Multi-file upload supported. Backend accepts certificate_scans[] array.

contract_signing_date.details: Contract tab has 'Müqavilənin bağlanma tarixi' field. Backend accepts contract_signing_date. Detail view shows field with backward compat to contract_start_date.

work_start_date.details: Contract tab has 'İşə başlama tarixi' field. Backend accepts work_start_date.

contract_indefinite.details: Contract tab has 'Müddətsiz' checkbox next to contract_end_date. When checked, date input is disabled. Backend accepts contract_indefinite boolean.

contract_reminder.details: Contract tab has 'Xatırlatma (bitməsinə 1 ay qalmış)' checkbox, checked by default. Backend accepts contract_reminder boolean.

position_change.details: Contract tab has 'Vəzifə dəyişikliyi' select with Bəli/Xeyr options. Backend accepts position_change boolean.

payment_system.details: Contract tab has 'Əməyin ödənilməsi sistemi' select with Vaxtamuzd/İşəmuzd options. Backend accepts payment_system string.

contract_file_uploads.details: Contract tab has 3 file upload buttons: Vəzifə təlimatları, Əmək müqaviləsi, Vəzifə dəyişikliyi faylı. Backend accepts position_instructions_file, employment_contract_file, position_change_file.

salary_supplement.details: Salary tab has 'Əmək haqqına əlavə (AZN)' input. Backend accepts salary_supplement number.

bonuses.details: Salary tab has 'Mükafatlar' input. Backend accepts bonuses string.

detail_view_salary_4_cards.details: Employee detail view Salary tab shows 4 cards: Gross əmək haqqı, Net əmək haqqı, Əlavə, Mükafatlar.

detail_view_contract_new_fields.details: Employee detail view Contract tab shows all new fields: Müqavilənin bağlanma tarixi, İşə başlama tarixi, Müqavilənin bitmə tarixi, Sınaq müddəti bitmə, Vəzifə dəyişikliyi, Əməyin ödənilməsi, Xatırlatma.

detail_view_documents_sertifikatlar.details: Employee detail view Documents tab shows Sertifikatlar section when certificate_scans exist.
